stories.title: ConnectLife loses blood donations due to FAA ground stop; seeking donations from community
stories.summary: ConnectLife is asking Western New Yorkers to donate blood after the FAA's nationwide ground stop caused dozens of blood samples to go bad.

stories.title: Amherst Police locate missing endangered person
stories.summary: Amherst police say the individual has been safely located.

stories.title: Buffalo firefighters investigate blaze at vacant East Side home
stories.summary: Buffalo firefighters are investigating a fire that heavily damaged a vacant home on the city's East Side on Sunday morning.

stories.title: Bills' Josh Allen, James Cook make NFL history in Bills win over Jets
stories.summary: Josh Allen and James Cook both reached historic NFL milestones during Buffalo's 31-12 win over the Jets. See the records that put the Bills duo in elite company.

stories.title: Buffalo Christkindlmarkt plans biggest holiday market yet
stories.summary: Buffalo Christkindlmarkt returns this week with tree-lighting ceremonies, seasonal food and drinks, family activities and more.

stories.title: Police seek additional victims in Genesee County theft investigation
stories.summary: The Genesee County Sheriff's Office says an Elba man faces multiple charges and is encouraging potential victims to contact their local police department.

stories.title: Hochul announces $2.17M to redevelop former Bethlehem Steel site
stories.summary: The transformation of the former Bethlehem Steel property is getting another boost. A new $2.17 million state grant will support infrastructure improvements.

stories.title: Bills fans turn watch parties into community and charity
stories.summary: From routine game-day gatherings to unexpected Buffalo detours, fans find a home away from home.

stories.title: Santa Claus stopping at the Herschell Carrousel Museum this holiday season
stories.summary: Santa Claus will be coming to the Herschell Carrousel Museum this holiday season for special carrousel rides for the whole family.

stories.title: Gas leak closes Anchor Bar in Amherst 'until further notice,' Bills alumni watch party postponed
stories.summary: A gas leak at the Anchor Bar in Amherst has closed the restaurant for the near future, their 'Winging It Watch Party' with Bills alum Scott Norwood is cancelled.

stories.title: Niagara Square bollards won't slow snow removal, Buffalo officials say
stories.summary: City officials say snow-clearing equipment will be able to navigate around the bollards as Buffalo continues work toward a larger redesign of the downtown landmark.

stories.title: Two top-prize winning TAKE 5 tickets sold in Western New York
stories.summary: The New York Lottery says that two top-prize winning TAKE 5 tickets were sold in WNY for Saturday's evening drawing. Check your tickets!
